documentation_basis.rule: For a relationship whose type is in formal_act_relationships: announcement-or-description when every record it cites has an evidence_type in announcement_evidence_types, otherwise includes-non-announcement-record. For any other relationship: declaration-or-event. Describes how a relationship is documented in this registry, not whether it is true. documented_as and documentation_basis are independent: a row can read Signed while resting only on an announcement.

values.announcement-or-description: A formal-act relationship whose every cited record has one of the announcement evidence types. These are listed in GAP-05.
values.declaration-or-event: Any other relationship: declarations, public events and a programme's stated composition, whose primary record is an announcement. Not measured this way.
values.includes-non-announcement-record: A formal-act relationship that cites at least one record of another type: an official report, a regulatory record, an official gazette text, a technical repository, a publication, a ranking or a direct observation. Such a record is not the instrument itself: an official gazette text records a legal act about it, such as its approval, and a signed text would have evidence_type signed_instrument.

documented_as.rule: Derived from the relationship's classification and, for VERIFIED FACT, its relationship type. It never upgrades a record.

derivation.evidence: For each record the relationship cites: its id, source_url, source_type, evidence_type, publication_date and retrieval_date, copied from evidence.json.
derivation.object.lifecycle: The related entity's lifecycle key from ontology.json (defined in its lifecycle_stages); null for entity types without a lifecycle.

object.stage.rule: A display label: labels[object.lifecycle], followed by availability_suffix when the stage is operational or pilot and every lifecycle_evidence record declaring that stage (status_evidence equal to it) has status_basis public-availability-observed. Other bases (an operator's or independent report of use, an independent listing) add nothing to the label. Use object.lifecycle and the records' status_basis for machine processing.

derivation.object.status_as_recorded: The related entity's free-text status field in ontology.json; null when absent.

qualifications.rule: Explanatory sentences for readers, in this order, each added when its condition holds. Not a controlled vocabulary.

rules.when: The relationship has a note in ontology.json

rules.text: The signing is documented by a report of it; the signed text is not recorded in this registry.
rules.when: documented_as is Signed and no cited record is a signed_instrument whose instrument.signatories include the subject

rules.text: A cited official gazette record documents the legal approval of the instrument, not its signed text, and is not a report of the signing.
rules.when: documented_as is Signed and a cited record has evidence_type official_gazette

rules.text: A signature is recorded as a signature; delivery is not documented.
rules.when: documented_as is Signed and object.lifecycle is announced

rules.text: Documented here only by announcements, news reports or descriptions (GAP-05).

derivation.row_id: subject|relationship|object, joined with '|'. A relationship is identified by this triple, which is unique in ontology.json.
derivation.row_order: Rows are sorted by the tuple (subject, relationship, object), compared element by element as strings; not by row_id, so 'um6p|…' sorts before 'um6p-ventures|…'. Each row's evidence keeps the order of the relationship's evidence list in ontology.json.

row_selection.rule: Every relationship in ontology.json whose subject has one of subject_types and whose object has one of object_types.

derivation.subject.name, object.name, object.type: Copied from the entity in ontology.json.
